CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE EDITIONABLE VIEW "UATDTA"."FQAVIS02" ("GDJOBNBR", "GDOBNM", "GDVERS", "GDCTR", "GDFY", "GDTPN", "GD55VISGAC1", "GD55VIVERCO", "GDKCO", "GDDCT", "GDDOC", "GDDGJ", "GDJELN", "GDEXTL", "GDLT", "GDPN", "GDCRCD", "GDR026", "GDRP35", "GDAA10", "GDTICKER", "GDR1VFC", "GDAA") AS 
  WITH RUNJOB_LT AS (
    SELECT 
    DISTINCT RNJOBNBR,
    TRIM(REGEXP_SUBSTR(t.RN55VILTLST, '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL)) AS RNLT
    FROM "UATDTA".FQAVIS01 t
    WHERE RNEDSP= ' ' -- no procesado
    CONNECT BY REGEXP_SUBSTR(t.RN55VILTLST, '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL) IS NOT NULL
           AND PRIOR SYS_GUID() IS NOT NULL
           AND PRIOR t.ROWID = t.ROWID
),
RUNJOB_CO AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
    RNJOBNBR,
    --TRIM(REGEXP_SUBSTR(t.RN55VICOLST, '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL)) AS RNCO
    LPAD(TRIM(REGEXP_SUBSTR(t.RN55VICOLST, '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL)), 5, '0') AS RNCO
    FROM "UATDTA".FQAVIS01 t
    WHERE RNEDSP= ' ' -- no procesado
    CONNECT BY REGEXP_SUBSTR(t.RN55VICOLST, '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL) IS NOT NULL
           AND PRIOR SYS_GUID() IS NOT NULL
           AND PRIOR t.ROWID = t.ROWID
),
RUNJOB_RUB AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        RNJOBNBR,
        TRIM(REGEXP_SUBSTR(t.RN55VIRESLST, '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL)) AS RNRUB
    FROM "UATDTA".FQAVIS01 t
    WHERE RNEDSP = ' ' -- no procesado
    CONNECT BY REGEXP_SUBSTR(t.RN55VIRESLST, '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL) IS NOT NULL
           AND PRIOR SYS_GUID() IS NOT NULL
           AND PRIOR t.ROWID = t.ROWID
)
    SELECT
        RUNJOB.RNJOBNBR GDJOBNBR,
        RUNJOB.RNOBNM GDOBNM,
        RUNJOB.RNVERS GDVERS,
        RUNJOB.RNCTR GDCTR,
        RUNJOB.RNFY GDFY,
        RUNJOB.RNTPN GDTPN,
        CFG.VI55VISGAC1 GD55VISGAC1,
        RUNJOB.RN55VIVERCO  GD55VIVERCO,
        --F0911.GLMCU GDMCU,
        --F0911.GLOBJ GDOBJ,
        --F0911.GLSUB GDSUB,
        F0911.GLKCO GDKCO,
        F0911.GLDCT GDDCT,
        F0911.GLDOC GDDOC,
        F0911.GLDGJ GDDGJ,
        F0911.GLJELN GDJELN,
        F0911.GLEXTL GDEXTL,
        F0911.GLLT GDLT,        
        F0911.GLPN GDPN,
        --F0911.GLCRCD GDCRCD,        
        F0010.CCCRCD GDCRCD,
        F0901.GMR026 GDR026,
        -- se cambia RP35 x RP34
        --F0006.MCRP34 GDRP35,
        -- se omite el segmento para no agrupar x este campo cuando el codigo de rubrica no existe en la udc con SPHD=' '
        CASE WHEN TO_CHAR(NVL(F0901.GMR026,' ')) > ' ' AND EXISTS(SELECT '1' FROM "UATCTL".F0005 WHERE DRSY='09' AND DRRT='26' AND DRSPHD = 'Y' AND DRKY=RPAD(F0901.GMR026, 10, ' ')) THEN
            TO_CHAR(F0006.MCRP34)        
            ELSE
            ' '

        FQA09LTV.LYAA10 GDAA10,
        /*

        CASE  WHEN TO_CHAR(F0901.GMR019) IN ('DPS','DBV') THEN -- es intercompany
            --TO_CHAR(F0901.GMR019)

        CASE WHEN F0911.GLICUT='G' AND EXISTS(SELECT '1' FROM "UATCTL".F0005 WHERE DRSY='R1' AND DRRT='JE' AND DRKY=RPAD(F0911.GLDCT, 10, ' ')) THEN--TRIM(DRKY)=F0911.GLDCT) THEN
            CASE WHEN TO_CHAR(F0901.GMR026) < 'P00000' THEN
                CASE WHEN TO_CHAR(F0911.GLSBL) <> 'S' THEN
